Implement the user request autonomously. Use the repository contracts and existing tools. Do not ask questions or commit. This is a synthetic isolated experiment. Local Docker and loopback services are authorized; DOCKER_HOST selects the dedicated daemon. Never override its host or context. Use login:false for shell commands so the supplied PATH persists. Do not contact other external services.

Analyse a user-supplied file (PDF, archive, image, XML) with explicit bounds: input size,
decompressed size, time, memory and concurrency. When the library offers no such limit, run the
analysis outside the server process, with a deadline, an output cap, a memory cap and an empty
environment; a supervisor that fails to start stops its child. Every stop becomes an unreadable-file
outcome with the contracted fallback, while a saturated queue answers with a distinct retryable
refusal. A decompression-bomb test generated by the test accompanies the change; see `tdd`.

# Shop API
The test document envelope is SHOPPDF followed by a gzip-compressed XML attachment; it is synthetic, not a PDF conformance test.
The vendor API exposes extractAttachment(buffer) with no resource-bound parameter.
Approved limits: 64 KiB input, 1 MiB extracted XML, 200 ms parsing, 96 MiB RSS per parser, one active parser plus two queued jobs.
Unreadable returns 422 with kind unreadable and kept true. Saturation returns 503 with kind busy and Retry-After; it is retryable, not an unreadable attachment.
Run `bun test` and `bun build.mjs`; production runs dist/server.mjs. /health stays responsive while parsing.
All files and secrets in this fixture are synthetic.
dist/server.mjs: import {upload} from './upload.mjs';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';const attachments=new Map();const server=Bun.serve({port:0,async fetch(request){const url=new URL(request.url);if(url.pathname==='/health')return new Response('alive');if(url.pathname==='/attachment'){const data=attachments.get(url.searchParams.get('id'));return data?new Response(createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')):new Response('missing',{status:404});}const bytes=Buffer.from(await request.arrayBuffer());attachments.set(url.searchParams.get('id'),bytes);const result=await upload(bytes);return Response.json(result.body,{status:result.status,headers:result.status===503?{'Retry-After':'1'}:{}});}});console.log(server.port);

import {gunzipSync} from 'node:zlib';
export async function extractAttachment(buffer){if(buffer.subarray(0,7).toString()!=='SHOPPDF')throw new Error('bad envelope');const xml=gunzipSync(buffer.subarray(7)).toString();if(xml.includes('delay="1000"')){const end=Date.now()+1000;while(Date.now()<end){}}return xml;}
